dimensions.assessment: Affects all parties involved in civil litigation under ERISA, including plan fiduciaries, employee benefit plans, plaintiffs, and recordkeepers.
dimensions.evidence: For the purpose of any civil action under this section against a plan or its fiduciaries, all discovery and other proceedings shall be stayed

dimensions.assessment: Changes legal burdens of proof and automatically stays discovery during motion proceedings, impacting how ERISA lawsuits are litigated.
dimensions.evidence: a plaintiff has the burden of plausibly alleging and proving that the transaction is not exempt

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue changes are stated, though litigation and compliance time for private parties may be altered.
Amends Section 502 of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 to add statutory pleading standards and procedural stays.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 to strengthen the pleading standards for certain claims

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory amendment governing ongoing and future civil actions under ERISA.

missing_information: Quantitative impact on the number of dismissed or prolonged civil lawsuits.
Specific economic savings or costs for plan sponsors and litigants.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill alters civil litigation rules under ERISA by strengthening plaintiff burdens of proof regarding specific fiduciary exemptions and mandating discovery stays during pending motions, affecting ERISA plan fiduciaries, plaintiffs, and federal and state courts.
